turns.question: 订单所有者对 PAID 状态订单发起自助退款时，系统应按哪种资格规则放行？
turns.finding: The candidate combined ownership, state, amount, time-window, and fulfillment axes; the scripted user answered only the amount axis.
The runtime correctly blocked a same-revision eligibility repeat, so the revision-scoped guard exercised as designed.

turns.question: 订单所有者发起自助退款时，第一版应支持哪种退款金额范围？
turns.finding: The correct full-refund option was present, but the development oracle acceptance regex did not recognize the equivalent wording '仅全额退款/不接受部分金额' and submitted avoidable Other text.

candidateGate.reason: The guard no longer permanently blocked a new requirements revision, but a multi-axis question and an overly narrow oracle synonym matcher still produced a repeated business decision.
candidateGate.replacement: Add an explicit multi-axis negative few-shot and contract assertion; widen the development oracle acceptance pattern so a uniquely equivalent option is selected instead of Other.
